body:
I'm Ryan! I'm currently an undergraduate student at Northeastern University, studying for a Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering. My interest in this field has existed for most of my life. I've always had a knack for understanding electronics and digital logic design, but now I'm learning how to apply it to my professional career through CAD modeling, circuit design, and robotics.

	Besides my interest in electronics and electrical engineering, I'm a part of the starting roster for Northeastern's competitive Deadlock team. I am an avid enjoyer of Formula 1, though I do enjoy the occasional game of hockey. I also spend a lot of time in the culinary world, learning about food culture and history (mostly through experiencing it), and though I don't have much time for it nowadays, I used to maintain a vegetable and herb garden for my own cooking.

	Anyways, I made this portfolio as a more stylish and extensive way to show off my knowledge and skills. I really hope you enjoy it!

Best,
Ryan
